description: This line plot illustrates the trade-off between cost and reliability score for three different model configurations: the 3-Model Ensemble (blue line with circular markers), the 2-Model Ensemble (red line with circular markers), and GPT-4 (yellow line with circular markers), as evaluated in the PromptMind Team’s work at EHRSQL-2024. The x-axis, labeled “Cost,” spans from 0 to 10 on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Reliability Score,” ranges from 30 to 90, also on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 20. The blue line for the 3-Model Ensemble begins at approximately (0, 84) and declines gradually to about (10, 73). The red line for the 2-Model Ensemble starts slightly higher at approximately (0, 86), decreases more steeply than the 3-Model Ensemble, and ends near (10, 72). The yellow line for GPT-4 starts at the highest point, approximately (0, 89), and exhibits the steepest decline, reaching approximately (10, 41) — a drop of nearly 50 points — indicating a much sharper degradation in reliability as cost increases compared to the ensemble methods. All three lines are solid and connect circular data points at the plotted cost values.
